questions.question: What is the border color of card "Ancestor's Chosen"?

questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT fld005 FROM tab01 WHERE fld049 = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'

questions.question: Among the sets of cards that have an Italian translation, how many of them have a base set number of under 100?
questions.evidence: Italian translation refers to fld075 = 'Italian'; have a translation means fld094 is not null; base set number of under 100 refers to fld078 < 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T2.fld063 = T1.fld081 WHERE NOT T2.fld094 IS NULL AND T1.fld078 < 100 AND T2.fld075 = 'Italian'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T2.translation IS NOT NULL AND T1.baseSetSize < 100 AND T2.language = 'Italian'

questions.question: What is the Simplified Chinese translation of the name of the set "Eighth Edition"?
questions.evidence: Eighth Edition is the name of card set which refers to fld049 = 'Eighth Edition'; Simplified Chinese refers to fld075 = 'Chinese Simplified'; translation of the name refers to translation
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld094 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T2.fld063 = T1.fld081 WHERE T1.fld049 = 'Eighth Edition' AND T2.fld075 = 'Chinese Simplified'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.translation FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code WHERE T1.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified'

questions.question: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
questions.evidence: unknown power refers to fld055 = '*' or fld055 IS NULL; commander play format refers to fld076 = 'commander'; legal for commander play format refers to fld076 = 'commander' where fld077 = 'Legal'
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld001, T1.fld002 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE T2.fld077 = 'Legal' AND T2.fld076 = 'commander' AND (T1.fld055 IS NULL OR T1.fld055 = '*')
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.id, T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T2.status = 'Legal' AND T2.format = 'commander' AND (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*')

questions.question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
questions.evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(tab06.fld072)); the card is the promotional printing refers to fld029 = 1;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld049, T1.fld002, T1.fld029 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE T1.fld029 = 1 AND T1.fld002 = (SELECT fld002 FROM tab01 WHERE fld029 = 1 GROUP BY fld002 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fld072) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fld072) AS count_uuid FROM tab01 WHERE fld029 = 1 GROUP BY fld002))) LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist ))) LIMIT 1

questions.question: Calculate the percentage of the cards availabe in Chinese Simplified.
questions.evidence: Chinese Simplified' is the language; percentage = Divide(Sum(fld001 where fld075 = 'Chinese Simplified'), Count(fld001)) *100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.fld075 = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid

questions.question: List all the frame styles and cards Allen Williams worked on and find any banned cards if there are any.
questions.evidence: frame styles refers to fld019; cards Allen Williams worked on refers to fld002 = 'Allen Williams'; banned cards refers to fld077 = 'Banned'
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fld019, T1.fld049, IIF(T2.fld077 = 'Banned', T1.fld049, 'NO') FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab03 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'Allen Williams'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.frameVersion, T1.name , IIF(T2.status = 'Banned', T1.name, 'NO') FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.artist = 'Allen Williams'

questions.question: What is the percentage of Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box? List them by their ID.
questions.evidence: Story Spotlight cards that do not have a text box refers to isStorylight = 1 and fld034 = 0; Percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(count(fld001) where isStorylight = 1 AND fld034 = 0 ), SUM(count(fld001))) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fld034 = 0 AND fld033 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(fld001) FROM tab01
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 0 AND  isStorySpotlight = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) FROM cards

questions.question: What is the percentage of borderless cards?
questions.evidence: borderless card refers to fld005 = 'borderless'; percentage = Divide(Count (fld001) where fld005 = 'borderless', Count(fld001)) *100

questions.question: How many unknown power cards contain info about the triggered ability
questions.evidence: unknown power cards refers to fld055 is null or fld055 = '*';contain info about the triggered ability refers to text contains 'triggered ability'
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab06 AS T2 ON T1.fld072 = T2.fld072 WHERE (T1.fld055 IS NULL OR T1.fld055 = '*') AND T2.fld068 LIKE '%triggered ability%'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT Count(DISTINCT T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE (T1.power IS NULL OR T1.power = '*') AND T2.text LIKE '%triggered ability%'

questions.question: Which of these artists have designed a card in the set Coldsnap, Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; Jeremy Jarvis, Aaron Miller or Chippy are the name of artists which refers to fld002 IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller','Chippy');
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld002 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T2.fld081 = T1.fld063 WHERE (T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld002 = 'Chippy') OR (T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld002 = 'Aaron Miller') OR (T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld002 = 'Jeremy Jarvis') GROUP BY T1.fld002
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Chippy') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Aaron Miller') OR (T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist = 'Jeremy Jarvis') GROUP BY T1.artist

questions.question: What is the percentage of incredibly powerful cards in the set Coldsnap?
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; foil is incredibly powerful refers to fld006 is not null AND fld007 is not null; the percentage of incredibly powerful tab01 in the set refers to DIVIDE(SUM(incredibly powerful), SUM(fld049 = 'Coldsnap'))*100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN NOT T1.fld006 IS NULL AND NOT T1.fld007 IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T2 ON T2.fld081 = T1.fld063 WHERE T2.fld049 = 'Coldsnap'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND T1.cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T2.code = T1.setCode WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap'

questions.question: Among the Artifact cards, which are black color and comes with foreign languague translation?

questions.question: List the names of all the cards in the set Hour of Devastation and find the formats in which these cards are legal.

questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name , CASE WHEN T1.status = 'Legal' THEN T1.format ELSE NULL END FROM legalities AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T2.setCode IN ( SELECT code FROM sets WHERE name = 'Hour of Devastation' )

questions.question: Please list the Italian names of the cards in the set Coldsnap with the highest converted mana cost.
questions.evidence: card set Coldsnap refers to fld049 = 'Coldsnap'; Italian refers to fld075 = 'Italian'; highest converted mana cost refers to MAX(fld011)
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.fld049 FROM tab02 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T2 ON T2.fld072 = T1.fld072 INNER JOIN tab04 AS T3 ON T3.fld081 = T2.fld063 WHERE T3.fld049 = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.fld075 = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.fld011 DESC
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T2.name FROM foreign_data AS T1 INNER JOIN cards AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid INNER JOIN sets AS T3 ON T3.code = T2.setCode WHERE T3.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.language = 'Italian' ORDER BY T2.convertedManaCost DESC
